description: Test why a real sent email lands in spam: SPF, DKIM, DMARC and deliverability report. $0.05 USDC on Base per call. Get a free test address via POST /v1/tests, send one email to it, then call this with test_id and X-Read-Token. Returns SPF, DKIM, DMARC, ARC, BIMI, rDNS, SpamCop, unsubscribe and content checks, a 0-100 score and top fixes. Don't use this for checking a domain without sending mail; use /v1/fix-plan. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
